chunks: No people can hasten or delay the term already fixed for them.
ai.seo_question: When can a nation's appointed time be hastened or delayed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of God over the temporal existence of nations, affirming that the 'ajal' (appointed term) is immutable regardless of human effort or divine decree. It serves as a reminder that the fall of civilizations is not due to chance but is a precise execution of divine will, often linked to the accumulation of moral decay or the rejection of prophets. This concept reinforces the Shia belief in the inevitability of divine justice and the ultimate triumph of truth over temporal powers.
